clue.text: Accompanying the little devil, you get everything together–and can't be blamed this way!

parts.note: to accompany someone is to go with them
an imp is a small mischievous devil
unity is the state of all being joined as one

explanation.surface: Keep company with a small devil and gather everything up, and you will escape all blame.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes a manner of acting, so the answer is an adverbial phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting without fear of punishment or consequence is acting in a way for which you cannot be held to account.

clue.text: Toss a lousy dime over some protection against spills as this is drunk.

indicators.note: the jumbled coin is placed over the bib, covering it on both sides
a lousy version of the word is a poor, jumbled one

parts.note: taken as written
a bib protects clothes from spills

explanation.surface: Throw a worthless coin onto a bib, as befits something that has been swallowed.
explanation.definitionFit: To imbibe is to drink, so what has been imbibed has been consumed as a beverage.

clue.text: Places for a straw type (or felt, or wool), but you wouldn't expect them to sprout your topper!

definitions.text: Places for a straw type (or felt, or wool), but you wouldn't expect them to sprout your topper!

parts.words: Places for a straw type (or felt, or wool)
parts.note: straw, felt and wool are kinds of hat, and these are stands to hang them on

parts.words: you wouldn't expect them to sprout your topper
parts.note: the joke is that these stands are called trees, yet they grow no hats

explanation.walkthrough: A topper is a top hat; the clue teases that these stands are named like plants but do not produce anything.
explanation.definitionFit: These upright stands with branching pegs are furniture for hanging headwear in a hallway.

clue.text: A small unit of mass or weight could make you sick in a Russian airplane and crash.

definitions.text: A small unit of mass or weight

indicators.note: being sick inside the airplane puts that word within its name

parts.note: MiG is a Russian fighter jet
ill means sick
to ram is to crash into

explanation.surface: Feeling unwell aboard a Soviet jet that then crashes.
explanation.definitionFit: A milligram is one thousandth of a gram, a tiny metric measure of mass.

clue.text: Recommends a sort of surge.

indicators.note: a sort of the word is a rearranged version of its letters

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone advises a particular kind of sudden rush forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To urge a course of action is to advise or press for it strongly.

clue.text: In a capital, I can form a different kind of letter.

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: In a city that is a capital, someone can create another type of letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' and 'letter' suggest typography; the answer is a slanted typeface.
explanation.definitionFit: Italic type is a sloping style of print, a distinct form of lettering from upright roman.

clue.text: As you can gather, I did shy badly from a High German language with bits and pieces from many tongues.

definitions.text: a High German language with bits and pieces from many tongues

indicators.note: doing something badly scrambles the letters of the phrase

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone admits to shying away from a German-based language that borrows widely.
explanation.definitionFit: Yiddish grew from medieval High German dialects and absorbed Hebrew, Aramaic and Slavic vocabulary.

clue.text: A brash way of trying to make a hit with the gal, though they sometimes earn a few points on the field.

definitions.text: A brash way of trying to make a hit with the gal
definitions.meaning: first meaning: bold advances made at a woman

definitions.text: they sometimes earn a few points on the field
definitions.meaning: second meaning: throws downfield in American football

explanation.walkthrough: To make a pass at someone is to flirt; forward also means brash. In American football a forward pass can lead to a touchdown.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes both bold romantic advances and a throwing play in gridiron football.

clue.text: Not the grinning cow in the ads–just one considered the butt of the joke.

definitions.text: Not the grinning cow in the ads–just one considered the butt of the joke.

parts.note: read literally, the answer would be cattle that laugh, as in an advertising mascot
a person everyone laughs at

explanation.walkthrough: Stock means livestock, so the answer literally sounds like amused cattle; the clue rejects that reading for the idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: A laughingstock is a person subjected to general ridicule and mockery.

clue.text: A small portion in spoken form, which might describe the movement of the spheres.

definitions.text: which might describe the movement of the spheres

indicators.note: the small portion is placed inside the word for spoken form

parts.note: oral means spoken rather than written
a bit is a small piece

explanation.surface: A little piece put into speech that could suit the motion of heavenly bodies.
explanation.definitionFit: Planets and other celestial spheres travel in orbits, so their motion is described by this adjective about circling paths.

clue.text: Moses is a perfect example–as well as in a mixture of a gram of it.

definitions.note: the definition names an example, read as 'something of which Moses is a perfect example'

indicators.note: the word for as well as goes inside the mixed letters
a mixture stirs up the letters of the word gram

parts.note: taken as written
and means as well as

explanation.surface: A biblical figure illustrated, alongside something about mixing a gram of a substance.
explanation.walkthrough: Moses is not the prophet here: Grandma Moses (Anna Mary Robertson Moses) was a celebrated American folk painter who began painting in her seventies.
explanation.definitionFit: The painter's popular nickname makes her the perfect instance of an elderly grandmother, so the title fits.

clue.text: What a spider makes with some hesitation implied–as a music-maker, too!

parts.note: a spider spins a web
er is the sound of hesitating in speech

explanation.surface: A spider's work with a hesitant pause, which also counts as making music.
explanation.walkthrough: Carl Maria von Weber was a German Romantic composer, best known for the opera Der Freischütz.
explanation.definitionFit: A composer creates music, and this German composer of operas fits the description of one who makes it.

clue.text: Giving you motivation–but you can't say you didn't inhale while you were doing it!

definitions.meaning: first meaning: stirring you to act, encouraging

definitions.text: you can't say you didn't inhale while you were doing it
definitions.meaning: second meaning: drawing breath in, the literal sense of inspire

explanation.walkthrough: The second half is a playful way of describing breathing in, since to inspire literally means to inhale.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both encouraging and, in the physiological sense, taking air into the lungs.

clue.text: A false lead, according to the color of the lady's band.

parts.note: red is a color
her is the possessive for a lady
a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: A misleading clue lies in the colour of a woman's wedding band.
explanation.definitionFit: A red herring is a distraction that sends an investigator down the wrong trail, an idiom from mystery stories.

clue.text: A tennis professional, in good shape for what the business hopes to make.

definitions.text: what the business hopes to make

parts.note: the net is central to tennis
pro is short for professional
fit means healthy and in good condition

explanation.surface: A tennis pro in fine condition is just what the company wants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A tennis professional' looks like one person; it splits into the court's net and a pro.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm aims for earnings left after all costs are deducted, its real gain.

clue.text: The shape of the hat I found in a different country?

indicators.note: the shape of a set of letters is their arrangement, which is changed here

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A hat's shape that the wearer spotted while abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes people or things belonging to Thailand, a foreign nation in Southeast Asia.

clue.text: A girl who just came out on the radio show–smart-looking, too!

parts.words: A girl who just came out
parts.note: a debutante, or deb, is a young woman just introduced to society
a broadcast is on air

explanation.surface: A young society girl appears on a radio show, looking stylish too.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair describes someone suave and stylishly dressed, with confident charm.

clue.text: Junior to 11 by one generation, like Hemingway…

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a father, the generation below a grandparent
second meaning: Ernest Hemingway's famous nickname

explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference points to the grandmother answer, and one generation down from her is a parent.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a familiar name for a father and was the nickname the novelist Hemingway enjoyed in later life.

clue.text: Flavorful ratio starting a quantity of this.

parts.note: pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter

indicators.note: only the starting letters of the word quantity are used, its tail dropped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A tasty mathematical ratio opens a measured amount of this.
explanation.definitionFit: Piquant food is pleasantly sharp or spicy, full of taste.

clue.text: …whose mate gets to make music around her, which may bother your 13.

definitions.note: the definition is a description of the answer as an adjective

indicators.note: the music-making word is wrapped around the mate just named

parts.note: to sing is to make music
the mate of the father in the previous clue is the mother

explanation.surface: Continuing the family theme, the father's wife sings around her, which might disturb your breathing.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to the father clue, so his mate is the mother; 13 is the inhaling answer, read here as breathing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something stifling cuts off the air, which is exactly what interferes with breathing in.

clue.text: Possible train, i.e., but not a moving description.

definitions.note: the definition is a phrase describing what the answer is, a noun

indicators.note: the letters give a possible arrangement other than their written one

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A train, perhaps, though not one that moves.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia is the tendency of a body to remain at rest, a state of being stationary or sluggish.

clue.text: Male or female on an Asian holiday, capable of making quite a bit of music.

definitions.text: capable of making quite a bit of music
definitions.note: the definition describes the answer, a noun naming a group

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: sex is the category of male or female
Tet is the Vietnamese lunar new year festival

explanation.surface: A man or woman on holiday in Asia who can make plenty of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A sextet is a group of six musicians, enough performers to produce a full sound.

clue.text: The oracle is about to make a search, and withdraw into solitude.

indicators.note: the oracle's word goes around the search, enclosing it

parts.note: a seer foretells the future like an oracle
to quest is to go searching

explanation.surface: A prophet sets out on a search and then retreats from company.
explanation.definitionFit: To sequester oneself is to retire into seclusion, apart from other people.

clue.text: Where a yodel might be expected.

definitions.text: Where a yodel might be expected.

parts.note: asks for a place
yodelling is the traditional singing of the Alpine regions

explanation.definitionFit: The Tyrol is an Alpine region of Austria and Italy, famous for its folk tradition of yodelling.

clue.text: It's obvious that this is nothing to a heraldic color!

parts.note: O is the shape of zero, nothing
vert is green in heraldry

explanation.surface: A remark that a coat-of-arms colour plainly means nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overt is done openly and plainly visible, not hidden.

clue.text: A former player on the stage is a demanding type!

parts.note: ex- means former
an actor is a stage player

explanation.surface: A retired actor turns out to be a difficult person to please.
explanation.definitionFit: An exactor is one who exacts, insisting on payment or obedience from others.

clue.text: One of Kukla's friends gets a shake, and is wild with excitement!

parts.note: Kukla, Fran and Ollie was an American TV puppet show, and Fran Allison was its human host
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: A TV puppet's companion develops a twitch and gets overexcited.
explanation.walkthrough: Kukla, Fran and Ollie was a popular early American children's television programme.
explanation.definitionFit: Being frantic means being beside yourself, distraught or frenzied with emotion.

clue.text: Describing a party that brooks no opposition.

definitions.text: Describing a party that brooks no opposition.

parts.note: the party is political, not a celebration
allowing no rival party or dissent at all

explanation.walkthrough: A party here might be a social gathering, but the clue means a political party ruling alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-party state that suppresses all dissent and controls every aspect of life is the regime this adjective names.
